en_summary: $GS CEO: The people developing AI models and infrastructure have to take responsibility for what they're building so that it works and doesn't do harm. text:
$GS CEO: "The people that are developing these [AI] models and the infrastructure that allow the technology to exist and ultimately be deployed in the economy have to take responsibility for what they're building, and that it works, and that it doesn't do harm. And then the companies that take those products and embed them in their enterprises and their service have to be responsible for the way they're deployed and the impact that they have.

"And the third is not getting as much attention, but it's equally important. Goldman Sachs has been using AI-type models for trading platforms for almost 20 years, but there's human accountability attached to every one of those platforms.

"I could never imagine someone at Goldman Sachs saying to me, "The trading platform went off and did something awful on its own. We couldn't stop it." We wouldn't deploy it if we didn't feel that we had the control to manage it appropriately, and that there was a human being that was ultimately accountable for anything that goes wrong."

This hasn't proven too weak overall outside of short-term churning, & suspect June/July lows (where the stock is trading now) could act as support tomorrow ahead of a recovery attempt into Nov

However, similar to $GOOGL, i don't find buying dips all that attractive when met with huge high to low ranges on big volume.  They tend to normally be wave 3 moves and even on a mild recovery, i suspect mid-Nov into Nov expiration might prove tricky-  Nov 11-Nov 20 timeframe

Ultimately, many continue to fail to see the improvement in the broader mkt and are putting too much stock in this minor (granted, outsized) move in Tech these last couple weeks.   Did they forget what happened Mon-Wed of this week? 

Symmetrically, QQQ bottomed Fri 10/16, it bottomed Friday 10/23 and what does it do tomorrow, 10/23? ____
Breadth & positive divergence are key.   Stay tuned.

@IBDinvestors @Marketsurge charts by #IBD show great clarity on this minor rally failure & breakdown.  but ultimately should prove short-lived.
